sentences.en: I did not miss my purse till I got home.
sentences.zh: 直到到家我才意识到我的钱包不见了。

sentences.en: I did not miss my purse until I returned home.
sentences.zh: 直到回到家我才发现没带钱包。

sentences.en: I had my purse stolen somewhere on my way home.
sentences.zh: 回家路上有人偷了我的钱包。

senses.zh: (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力
